data.name: Block_Up
data.comment: Name of the move-up block.

data.name: Block_Down
data.comment: Name of the move-down block.

data.name: Block_Left
data.comment: Name of the move-left block.

data.name: Block_Right
data.comment: Name of the move-right block.

data.name: Palette_Title
data.comment: Heading above the block palette.

data.name: Program_Title
data.comment: Heading above the program list.

data.name: Program_Remove
data.comment: Accessible name of the remove button. {0} = block number, starting at 1.

data.name: Program_Clear
data.comment: Button that removes all blocks from the program.

data.name: Program_Block
data.comment: Accessible name of a program block. {0} = block number, starting at 1; {1} = direction name.

data.name: Control_Play
data.comment: Button that runs the whole program.

data.name: Control_Debug
data.comment: Button that runs the program one step at a time.

data.name: Control_Reset
data.comment: Button that stops the run and puts the hero back on the start.

data.name: Controls_Title
data.comment: Accessible name of the control area.

data.name: Tempo_Label
data.comment: Label of the speed slider.

data.name: Tempo_Slow
data.comment: Slowest speed step.

data.name: Tempo_Medium
data.comment: Middle speed step.

data.name: Tempo_Fast
data.comment: Fastest speed step.

data.name: Status_Label
data.comment: Accessible prefix of the run status.

data.name: Status_Ready
data.comment: Status: nothing has run yet.

data.name: Status_Running
data.comment: Status: the program runs.

data.name: Status_Paused
data.comment: Status: stopped between two debug steps.

data.name: Status_Failed
data.comment: Status: the run ended with an error.

data.name: Status_Succeeded
data.comment: Status: the hero reached the castle.

data.name: Program_Current
data.comment: Accessible hint on the block that runs now.

data.name: Program_Hint
data.comment: Accessible hint on the empty repeat block that stopped the start.

data.name: Program_Error
data.comment: Accessible hint on the block that caused the error.

data.name: Palette_Repeat
data.comment: Palette button that adds a repeat block.

data.name: Block_Repeat
data.comment: Accessible name of a repeat block. {0} = repeat count.

data.name: Repeat_Before
data.comment: Text before the count controls in the header of a repeat block.

data.name: Repeat_After
data.comment: Text after the count controls in the header of a repeat block.

data.name: Repeat_Decrease
data.comment: Accessible name of the minus button. {0} = block number, for example 3 or 3.2.

data.name: Repeat_Increase
data.comment: Accessible name of the plus button. {0} = block number, for example 3 or 3.2.

data.name: Program_MoveUp
data.comment: Accessible name of the move-up button. {0} = block number, for example 3 or 3.2.

data.name: Program_MoveDown
data.comment: Accessible name of the move-down button. {0} = block number, for example 3 or 3.2.

data.name: InsertTarget_Root
data.comment: Line above the program: the next block is appended to the end of the program.

data.name: InsertTarget_Repeat
data.comment: Line above the program: the next block goes into this repeat block. {0} = block number, for example 3 or 3.2.

data.name: Repeat_Round
data.comment: {0} = current round (1-based), {1} = total rounds of the repeat block that is running.

data.name: Message_Obstacle_Tree
data.value: Autsch! Da steht ein Baum im Weg. Schau dir Baustein {0} noch einmal an.
data.comment: {0} = block number of the move that was blocked, for example 6 or 3.2.

data.name: Message_Obstacle_Rock
data.value: Autsch! Da liegt ein Stein im Weg. Schau dir Baustein {0} noch einmal an.
data.comment: {0} = block number of the move that was blocked.

data.name: Message_Obstacle_Pond
data.value: Autsch! Da ist ein Teich im Weg. Schau dir Baustein {0} noch einmal an.
data.comment: {0} = block number of the move that was blocked.

data.name: Message_OutOfBounds
data.value: Hoppla! Hier ist die Welt zu Ende. Baustein {0} führt aus dem Spielfeld.
data.comment: {0} = block number of the move that left the board.

data.name: Message_GoalNotReached
data.value: Dein Programm ist fertig, aber {0} ist noch nicht bei der Burg. Probier es nochmal!
data.comment: {0} = hero name.

data.name: Message_ItemsMissing_One
data.value: Fast geschafft! Es fehlt noch 1 Erdbeere.
data.comment: Exactly one strawberry is missing.

data.name: Message_ItemsMissing_Other
data.value: Fast geschafft! Es fehlen noch {0} Erdbeeren.
data.comment: {0} = number of missing strawberries (2 or more).

data.name: Message_StepLimitExceeded
data.value: Puh! Dein Programm macht mehr als {0} Schritte. Brauchst du wirklich so viele Wiederholungen?
data.comment: {0} = step limit (1000).

data.name: Message_Succeeded
data.value: Geschafft, {0}! Du hast die Burg erreicht.
data.comment: {0} = hero name.

data.name: Message_EmptyRepeat
data.value: Leg zuerst Bausteine in den Wiederhole-Block.
data.comment: Hint when Play or Debug is pressed with an empty repeat block.

data.name: Message_EmptyProgram
data.value: Zieh Bausteine ins Programm oder klick sie an.
data.comment: Hint while the program has no blocks.

data.name: Message_ProgramFull
data.value: Dein Programm ist voll. Lösch zuerst einen Baustein.
data.comment: Hint when the maximum number of blocks is reached.

data.name: Message_NestingTooDeep
data.value: Hier passt kein weiterer Wiederhole-Block hinein.
data.comment: Hint when no repeat block fits into the insert target (nesting too deep).

data.name: Palette_DropDelete
data.comment: Shown over the palette while a program block is dragged: dropping it there removes it.

data.name: Start_Title
data.comment: Heading of the start page.

data.name: Start_Intro
data.value: Such dir eine Figur und ein Level aus. Dann bringst du deinen Helden mit Bausteinen zur Burg.
data.comment: Short explanation on the start page.

data.name: Start_HeroGroup
data.comment: Label of the group of hero cards.

data.name: Start_NameLabel
data.comment: Label of the hero name field.

data.name: Start_NameHint
data.comment: Hint below the hero name field.

data.name: Start_LevelsTitle
data.comment: Heading above the level cards.

data.name: Start_Go
data.comment: Button that starts the chosen level.

data.name: Hero_Change
data.comment: Button on the play page that goes back to the start page.

data.name: Hero_BadgeLabel
data.comment: Accessible name of the hero badge on the play page.

data.name: Level_Next
data.comment: Button on the play page after a success: load the next level.

data.name: Level_Solved
data.comment: Appended to the accessible name of a solved level card.

data.name: Message_AllSolved
data.comment: Second sentence of the success message once every level is solved.
